title: MAMMOGRAPHY REPORT
draft_note: Preliminary report prepared with AI assistance. It requires review and signature by a radiologist.
comparison_none: No prior examinations available for comparison.

density.A: A — The breasts are almost entirely fatty.
density.B: B — There are scattered areas of fibroglandular density.
density.C: C — The breasts are heterogeneously dense, which may obscure small masses.
density.D: D — The breasts are extremely dense, which lowers the sensitivity of mammography.

density_unknown: Breast composition could not be assessed automatically.
ai_no_suspicious: The AI analysis did not identify features suspicious for malignancy. No suspicious masses, suspicious calcifications or architectural distortion are suggested by the model.
ai_suspicious: The AI analysis identified features that may be suspicious for malignancy. Targeted review of this breast by a radiologist is required.
ai_indeterminate: The AI analysis gives an intermediate result; careful review of this breast is recommended.
laterality_estimated: Note: breast side was determined automatically from the image and should be verified.
not_examined: No images of this breast were provided.
findings_need_category: The described findings have suspicious features, but the suggested category is lower than 4. The radiologist must set the final BI-RADS category.
ai_findings: Findings marked by the AI on the images (circled in red):
benign_mass_note: A lesion was detected while the malignancy score is low — probably benign (e.g. fibroadenoma, cyst). If it is known and stable, the radiologist may assign BI-RADS 2; on a screening exam, BI-RADS 0 (additional imaging).
detector_missing: The lesion detector is not installed: the model only estimates the probability of malignancy and does NOT detect benign lesions (fibroadenoma, cyst). Category 1, 2 or 3 must be confirmed by the radiologist.
split_note: Both breasts were in one image; it was split in the middle automatically (left half — right breast, right half — left breast). Please verify.

birads.0: Incomplete — additional imaging evaluation and/or prior mammograms are needed for comparison

rec.0: Additional imaging: spot-compression / magnification views and/or breast ultrasound; compare with prior mammograms if available.
rec.1: Routine screening mammography according to age and national guidelines.
rec.2: Routine screening mammography according to age and national guidelines.
rec.3: Short-interval follow-up: diagnostic mammography of the affected breast in 6 months (then 6 and 12 months, total 2 years of stability).
rec.4: Tissue diagnosis: image-guided core needle biopsy. Consultation with a breast surgeon / oncologist.
rec.4A: Tissue diagnosis: image-guided core needle biopsy. Consultation with a breast surgeon / oncologist.
rec.4B: Tissue diagnosis: image-guided core needle biopsy. Consultation with a breast surgeon / oncologist.
rec.4C: Tissue diagnosis: image-guided core needle biopsy. Consultation with a breast surgeon / oncologist.
rec.5: Tissue diagnosis: image-guided core needle biopsy as soon as possible. Consultation with an oncologist.
rec.6: Surgical excision / treatment when clinically appropriate. Management by an oncologist.

dense_note: Because of dense breast tissue (category {density}), supplemental breast ultrasound or MRI may be considered.
threshold_note: BI-RADS category was suggested automatically from the AI malignancy score. Score thresholds are not clinically validated and must be calibrated locally.
override_note: BI-RADS category set by the radiologist.
disclaimer: IMPORTANT: This software is not a certified medical device. The report is a draft for decision support only. The final diagnosis and BI-RADS assessment are the responsibility of the radiologist.
